newsitem.title: USA: Avid Tech Q2 revs aided by film, video.
newsitem.headline: Avid Tech Q2 revs aided by film, video.

text.p: Avid Technology Inc said on Wednesday that the increase in its second quarter revenues by 12.6 percent to $122.9 million came from "favorable demand" for its film and video products.
Lower material costs, reduced discounting, and a favorable product mix improved the company's margins to the highest level in two years, Avid said in a statement.
Avid, which was halted for trading on the Nasdaq, said it has expanded its indirect sales channel in North America and focused direct sales efforts on major accounts.
Avid said it has demonstrated a number of new products that are expected to stimulate revenue growth.
